copy.intro: Seats for eight and a roomy cabin, with power to every wheel. A sensible pick when the whole family needs one vehicle for the weekend.
good_for: Family visits with the whole group
Winter weekends out of the city

faq.question: How many seats does the Palisade have?
faq.answer: It has 8 seats with third-row seating, so a large group can travel together in one car.

faq.question: Is it good on snowy roads?
faq.answer: It sends power to every wheel, which helps with grip on snowy and slushy roads.

faq.question: What driver aids does it have?
faq.answer: Adaptive cruise control, lane keeping assist, blind spot assist and automatic emergency braking.

faq.question: Can I have it delivered?
faq.answer: Yes. You can collect it from us or have it delivered to your address. The delivery fee is shown on the booking page.
